notes:
- Added a new Ready Check feature
- Party leader sends "rc" in chat, resulting in a popup appearing for all party members that have the feature enabled
- Members can either press the "ready" or "not ready" button to signal that they are ready or not ready
- People who don't have the feature/mod can send "r" or "nr" in chat instead
- Once all members are ready, the popups close and the leader automatically sends a countdown in chat with sound effects (SFX can be disabled in settings)
- DPS Meter no longer uploads defeats to fareverlogs.fr
